summary: Stage unaligned singleton MXFP8 inputs in reserved scratch
compatibility: Prepared B12X kernels retain their aligned-input contract. The adapter reserves one BF16 input row alongside GEMM scratch and copies only an unaligned singleton view.
details: GLM TP3 KDA gate projections accept a contiguous single-row view whose source offset is not sixteen-byte aligned.
Caller-provided workspaces include the aligned staging region, including kernels with no GEMM scratch. CUDA graph execution allocates no staging storage.
